data.name: Ujval Mehta
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Ujval Mehta has made a big mark in cricket. With 22 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 38*, with an average of 12.50 and a quick strike rate of 122.70. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 17 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 23.1 overs, taking 14 wickets at an economy rate of 7.47. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
